raw.rationale: This launched lipoxygenase/COX inhibitor (likely a nonspecific anti-inflammatory such as a dihydroorotate dehydrogenase-unrelated agent) has no established cytotoxic mechanism or lineage-selective dependency at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-concentration screens rarely show lineage-selective killing for such compounds; probabilities are therefore near the low base rate with minor variation from lineage-specific ALOX5/PTGS1 expression.
